Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
Legendary Magic artist Victor Adame Minguez never fails to bring his high-quality best, and this drop is no exception. We let Victor loose on the theming and art, and uh, are you looking at them yet? Are you seeing this coolness? We love the heavy lean into futuristic vibes and the mix of grittiness and austerity. AND he collaborated with us on the flavor text—that’s range, people! Get on Team Victor and put these rad pieces in your deck or collection ASAP.

Contents:
• 1x Knight Exemplar
• 1x Knight of the White Orchid
• 1x Lord of the Undead
• 1x Compost
